elite.title: High-end service, without inflated fees.
elite.lead: GrupoRol offers an exclusive, first-class real estate service for those who expect excellence and financial efficiency at once. We break with the traditional luxury model: premium attention and tools, with more competitive fees than the sector usually charges.
elite.differentialBody: GrupoRol combines personalised attention, advanced technology, international reach and premium real estate services, without passing the usual luxury-sector cost structures on to the client.
elite.differentialHighlight: High-end service, with more competitive fees.
elite.closeTitle: Luxury does not have to cost more.

coverage.title: Global Coverage
coverage.body: We have no borders. We travel anywhere in the world to manage properties, carry out inspections or close negotiations in person.

tailored.title: Tailored Service
tailored.body: Every client and every transaction is different. We personalise the case completely and design a strategy around your financial, tax and logistical needs: a genuine made-to-measure real estate service.

tech.title: Cutting-Edge Visual Technology
tech.body: We maximise the value and reach of every property with premium digital tools, designed for national and international buyers.

finance.title: Financial Solutions and Debt Purchase
finance.body: We support financially complex real estate transactions: debt purchase, management and settlement of charges, restructuring and release of assets.
finance.accent: We resolve transactions others consider too complex.

network.title: International Network and Full Management
network.body: We work with international agencies and partners to multiply the visibility of every property, with discretion and personalised attention.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.intro: In compliance with Law 34/2002 of 11 July on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), users are informed of the identifying details of the owner of this website.
notice.purpose: This website is intended to provide information about the real estate services of {tradeName} and to facilitate contact with potential clients via forms, telephone, email and WhatsApp.
notice.terms1: Access to and use of this website confers the status of user and implies acceptance of these terms. The user undertakes to make appropriate use of the content and services offered.
notice.terms2: Contact forms link to Google Forms managed by the owner. By submitting them, the user accepts the conditions indicated in each form and in the privacy policy.
notice.ip: All website content (texts, images, logos, design) is the property of {tradeName} or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property law.
notice.liability1: {tradeName} is not liable for damage arising from improper use of the website or from information published by third parties through external links.
notice.liability2: Photographs, floor plans and property descriptions are indicative and may vary. Definitive contractual information will be provided at the time of the transaction.
notice.law: These terms are governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, the parties submit to the courts and tribunals of {jurisdiction}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: At {tradeName} ({legalName}) we process your personal data with the utmost care and in accordance with current data protection regulations (GDPR and LOPDGDD).
privacy.purpose: The personal data you provide through forms, email, telephone or WhatsApp will be processed in order to:

purposeList.requests: Handle your requests for information, purchase, sale, rental or valuation.
purposeList.services: Provide real estate brokerage and financing services.
purposeList.comms: Send communications related to your enquiry.

privacy.forms1: When you click the buttons on the website, you may access forms hosted on Google Forms (Google LLC). The data you enter is sent directly to the data controller to handle your request.
privacy.forms2: We recommend that you do not include sensitive information that is not necessary for your enquiry. You may exercise your rights by contacting us at the address indicated at the beginning of this policy.
privacy.finance1: In mortgage, personal loan or mortgage-debt forms, we may collect financial data (income, debts, employment situation).
privacy.finance2: This data will be processed exclusively to review your request and offer a suitable solution. It will not be disclosed to third parties without your express consent, except where legally required.
privacy.sensitive: Information relating to court proceedings, attachments or auctions is considered sensitive. We will treat it with strict confidentiality and solely to analyse your situation and propose alternatives.
privacy.legalBasis: The legal basis for processing is the data subject’s consent, the implementation of pre-contractual measures at the data subject’s request, and the legitimate interest in responding to enquiries.
privacy.retention: We will retain your data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, thereafter, for the legally established periods.
privacy.recipients1: We do not disclose your data to third parties, except where legally required or where necessary to provide the requested service (for example, financial institutions in the case of a mortgage application, with your prior authorisation).
privacy.recipients2: Google Forms may involve the processing of data by Google as a technology provider, in accordance with its own privacy policy.
privacy.rights1: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by sending an email to {email}.
privacy.rights2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This website uses local storage in your browser to remember basic preferences. Below we explain how it is used.
cookies.what: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They make it possible to remember preferences and improve site functionality.
cookies.useTitle: What we use on this website
cookies.use: In the current version of the site we use only:

useList.storage: Local storage (localStorage) to remember whether you have accepted or rejected the cookie notice.
useList.technical: Strictly necessary technical cookies for the basic operation of the site, if required by the hosting provider.

cookies.analytics: We currently do not install analytics cookies or audience-measurement tools. If they are introduced in the future, you will be informed and your consent will be requested where required.
cookies.manage1: When you access the website, a banner will be displayed where you can accept or reject non-essential cookies.
cookies.manage2: You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies and locally stored data. See your browser’s help for more information.
cookies.more1: For any enquiry about the use of cookies, you may contact us at {email}.
cookies.more2: Please also see our privacy policy for more information about the processing of your data.
